description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller class 'ShippingOptionsController' responsible for managing shipping options in an admin web interface. It includes methods for displaying shipping configuration pages, saving shipping options, and setting menu context. The controller interacts with services and utilities to retrieve and persist shipping configuration data.

classes.name: ShippingOptionsController
classes.description: Controller managing shipping options for the admin interface, including displaying and saving shipping configurations. It employs dependency injection for services and utilities and secures endpoints with role-based annotations.

methods.name: displayShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current shipping configuration, initializing defaults if none exist, and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: saveShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated shipping configuration, parsing and validating form inputs, and persisting changes.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method setting the menu context and active items for the view rendering.
